parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.lead:
A stiff metal wire is used to form a rectangular frame measuring 8.0 cm × 6.0 cm. The frame is open at the top, and is suspended from a sensitive newton meter, as shown in Fig. 8.1.

[[fig:f1]]

The open ends of the frame are connected to a power supply so that there is a current of 5.0 A in the frame in the direction indicated in Fig. 8.1.

The frame is slowly lowered into a uniform magnetic field of flux density *B* so that all of side PQ is in the field. The magnetic field lines are horizontal and at an angle of 50° to PQ, as shown in Fig. 8.2.

[[fig:f2]]

When side PQ of the frame first enters the magnetic field, the reading on the newton meter changes by 1.0 mN.
parts.text: Determine the magnetic flux density *B*, in mT.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State, with a reason, whether the change in the reading on the newton meter is an increase or a decrease.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
The frame is lowered further so that the vertical sides start to enter the magnetic field.

Suggest what effect this will have on the frame.

figures.caption: Fig. 8.1
figures.alt: A 6.0 cm by 8.0 cm rectangular wire frame, with a 5.0 A current, is suspended from a newton meter by insulating thread.

figures.caption: Fig. 8.2
figures.alt: A view from above shows the horizontal side PQ at 50° to parallel diagonal magnetic field lines, with arrows showing the field direction.
